exact_statement: For every finite uniform Boolean sign f, write p_j=Inf_j(f), c_ij=sum_{T off i,j in T} fhat(T)fhat(T+i), and tau_i=E_b[I(f_i=b)-min_U I(chi_U f_i=b)]. Then the child marginals are p_j+/-2c_ij and tau_i=(1/2)sum_{j!=i}[(2p_j+4c_ij-1)_+ +(2p_j-4c_ij-1)_+]. If p_j<=1/2 this equals sum_{j!=i}(p_j+2abs(c_ij)-1/2)_+. If max p_j<=1/4, every tau_i=0. For all K>=0, with D=H-KI, S_i^char=E_b[K min_U I(chi_U child)-H(child)], DTC=H-sum_i B_i, and JS_i=H-EH(child)-B_i, the exact SAME-bank identity DTC+(n-1)D+sum_i S_i^char+K sum_i tau_i=sum_i JS_i holds. On a least-essential-dimensional positive K-violator, all S_i^char>=0, so (n-1)D+K sum_i tau_i<=2I/ln2; if K>=2+3/ln2 all tau_i vanish. The rare/weak zero-release endpoint still admits every nonconstant Boolean seed with H/I preserved in the limit. A fixed N11 weak full-span affine-minimal Boolean root has zero character child release but strictly positive full-affine child release, without being critical.
